provenance: All limits here are illustrative research assumptions, NOT OEM relay or hospital safety ratings.
priority: strict lexicographic 0,1,2,3 then cost; each carrier normalized by total demand; P0-P2 lock abs tolerance 1e-7, P3 lock abs tolerance 1e-5, with relative tolerance
cascade: Delayed pre-control proxy subtracts incremental grid headroom, diesel reserve available after start delay, and executable P3/P2/P1 shedding (P0 preserved) before sharing residual across surviving GTs; not a network or relay simulation.
dynamic_temperature: baseline DOE zone mean temperature + uncalibrated 1R1C cold-loss perturbation
cost: uses historical 2001 prices from v2; diesel $0.30/kWh illustrative only
